picks.title: Puget Systems at SIGGRAPH 2026: an immersive Robo Dojo
picks.excerpt: ProVideo Coalition's SIGGRAPH 2026 dispatch spotlights AI-driven creative tools on the show floor: Beeble AI and District Cinema ran the new SwitchLight 3 model on native 4K cinematic footage from Corridor Crew's 'Son of a Dungeon' S3 to generate production-ready PBR relighting passes inside Unreal Engine, and Keyshot Studio's 'AI Shots' made focused generative edits while respecting CAD data and lighting — a concrete look at generative relighting in a real production pipeline.
picks.rationale: Only genuinely new movies story in the pool (published 2026-07-20); shows SwitchLight 3 generating production-ready PBR relighting passes in Unreal on real 4K footage plus Keyshot AI Shots — directly actionable generative-relighting workflow for VFX/design artists, from a credible post-production outlet.
